svg.aria-label: Apply the same six steps to every strip

g.text: Apply the same six steps to every strip
Each strip: 6 seconds; 25 mm/s and 10 mm/mV represented by the grid.
A: regular, one visible P per narrow QRS; R-R = 1.0 s
B: regular slow rhythm; R-R = 1.5 s. Is the patient perfusing?
C: rapid wide-complex pattern. Pulse and instability change the response.
Original teaching schematic. Not a patient ECG or a diagnostic simulator.
